_readme: Title-screen regression cases, derived from production outcomes. Every case is a posting the screen DROPPED that nevertheless reached the full scorer through the screened-out leak fixed in src/screen.py, so each carries a real band from the Sonnet scorer reading the full description. expected_keep=true where that band was top or strong (the screen was wrong to drop it); expected_keep=false where it was misfit (the screen was right). Keeping a posting that should drop costs one Sonnet scoring, so it grades WARN; dropping one that should keep loses the role outright and grades FAIL. Add a case whenever a screen drop turns out to have been a real role.
